summary: Iter 5 testing: 5 sets of new features on top of iter-4 baseline (profile page + change pwd + security question, upload validation, admin toggle/all_users + owner field, stats cards endpoint, keyboard shortcuts). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features_iter5.py with 15 new tests (all PASS) — full suite now 44/44 PASS (29 prior + 15 new). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow exercised every feature in the request and every flow passed.

verifications.backend_stats: GET /api/workorders/stats returns {pending,in_progress,completed,total,with_attachment} scoped to user; with admin + ?all_users=true returns global totals (>= personal totals). Non-admin passing all_users=true is silently ignored (still scoped).
verifications.backend_admin_view: GET /api/workorders?all_users=true as admin returns body.admin_view=true and each item has 'owner' field; same call as normal user returns admin_view=false (no other users' OTs leak).
verifications.backend_profile: PUT /api/auth/profile updates name (401 without auth). /api/auth/me reflects new name.
verifications.backend_change_password: POST /api/auth/change-password: wrong current -> 401; correct -> 200, new pwd logs in, old pwd 401.
verifications.backend_security_question: PUT /api/auth/security-question: wrong current -> 401; correct -> 200, /api/auth/forgot-password returns the updated question.
verifications.backend_upload_validation: .exe -> 400; valid .png -> 200; 11MB file -> 413; replacing attachment serves the new bytes via GET /attachment.
verifications.frontend_stats_cards: stats-grid + stat-card-total/-pending/-in-progress/-completed all visible. Counts update after create (Total 1, Pendientes 1 after creating one Pendiente OT, see screenshot).
verifications.frontend_shortcuts: 'N' opens Sheet (input#ot_number visible); '?' opens [data-testid=shortcuts-dialog]; '/' focuses search input ('Buscar por número de OT... ( / )'); typing 'n' inside search did NOT open the Sheet (shortcuts correctly suppressed while input focused); Esc closes overlays.
verifications.frontend_profile: /profile reached via user-menu-button -> link-to-profile; profile-title visible. Wrong current password -> profile-password-error shows 'La contraseña actual es incorrecta'. Correct -> success; after logout, OLD pwd produces login-error and NEW pwd logs in.
verifications.frontend_upload_exe: .exe set via input[type=file] -> sonner toast 'Tipo de archivo no permitido. Aceptados: .pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp, .xlsx, .docx, .xls, .doc, .txt, .csv, .zip' and filename does NOT appear in DOM as attachment.
verifications.frontend_admin_toggle: Normal user: admin-toggle-button NOT visible. Admin: visible, label toggles 'Vista personal' -> 'Vista global'; 'Vista global' badge appears in header; 'Vista global: el reordenamiento está deshabilitado' helper text visible; edit/delete buttons count = 0 in global view; owner is shown as a label under each OT (e.g. 'User' label on the row in screenshot).

critical_code_review_comments: All 5 feature sets implemented cleanly with proper data-testid coverage matching the spec.
Backend: stats endpoint correctly distinguishes admin+all_users=true from per-user scoping; owner field only enriched in admin global view.
Backend: upload validation is server-side (extension + size) AND frontend pre-validates via lib/uploadValidation.js — double defence is good.
Backend: change-password and security-question both require current_password verification (401 on mismatch) — correct.
Frontend: shortcuts are properly gated when an INPUT/TEXTAREA/contenteditable is focused — verified by typing 'n' in the search box (no Sheet opened).
Frontend: admin global view hides edit/delete actions and disables reorder — exactly as spec requested.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on every flow in the scope (stats cards, shortcuts N/?// + suppression, profile name/password/SQ, upload .exe rejection, admin toggle including global badge, hidden edit/delete, owner label, normal-user toggle hidden)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full app is in a green state. For regression, run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (currently 44/44 PASS in ~22s). New testids worth knowing: stats-grid, stat-card-*, admin-toggle-button, shortcuts-dialog, open-shortcuts-button, close-shortcuts-button, link-to-profile, profile-* (name/current-password/new-password/confirm-password/sq-* variants), back-to-dashboard. Backend exposes GET /api/workorders/stats and ?all_users=true on list+stats for admin only.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — feature additions verified end-to-end.
